description: Defines a FastAPI application with multiple endpoints demonstrating usage of request body examples, path, query, header, and cookie parameter examples, along with associated tests and OpenAPI schema generation.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model with a custom configuration, used as request body in endpoints and included in the OpenAPI schema.

methods.name: create_app()
methods.description: Creates and configures a FastAPI app with multiple endpoints demonstrating schema examples and deprecations.

methods.name: test_call_api()
methods.description: Tests various POST and GET endpoints for correct responses.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema()
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the generated OpenAPI schema, especially regarding example overrides.
